title: Hotels with an Alhambra view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Granada hotels with rooms that face the Alhambra, the exact category to book at each, and the city view and plain rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with an Alhambra view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels in Granada, Spain. Two sell room categories with the Alhambra in the name or description. A third is named only by travel guides, so we list it as reported.
teaser: From a junior suite named for the Alhambra to a boutique hotel whose room names don't say so.

shortAnswer.label: Only a guide names the room

decoder.text: Palacio Gran Vía sells a Deluxe City View as its own category, and it does not name the Alhambra. The Alhambra Junior Suite has the landmark in its name, so book that one.

decoder.left: Double or Twin Room with interior patio view
decoder.right: Superior Double or Twin Room with Alhambra view
decoder.text: At Shine Albayzin the room facing the interior patio is a separate category. A travel guide says the superior room with Alhambra in its name looks outwards to the Alhambra.
The Hotel Guru lists a plain Guest Room next to one named for the Alhambra. The plain room is sold without the view named, so book the one with the view in its name.

faq.q: Which Granada hotels sell rooms with an Alhambra view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, Palacio Gran Vía sells an Alhambra Junior Suite, and Shine Albayzin sells categories with Alhambra in the name. Hotel Casa 1800 is named only by travel guides, so no room is listed as sold with the view.

faq.q: Is a Deluxe City View at Palacio Gran Vía the same as an Alhambra view?
faq.a: No. The hotel sells a Deluxe City View as a separate category that does not name the Alhambra. Book the Alhambra Junior Suite, or the Royal Suite, whose terrace the hotel's page describes with views of the Alhambra.

faq.q: Does every room at Shine Albayzin look at the Alhambra?
faq.a: No. Great Small Hotels says the Alhambra views can be enjoyed from private balconies of some suites. Ask the hotel which room has the view before you book.
